prompt: Which ancient archaeoastronomical site in the U.K. is also associated with the summer solstice during which time light illuminates a quartz-rich stone in the chamber.
answer: Bryn Celli Ddu, a Neolithic passage tomb on Anglesey, Wales. At the summer solstice, sunlight shines down the passage and illuminates a quartz-rich stone inside the chamber.
